title: vilmiComfort
description: vilmiComfort: Minecraft reimagined - bigger worlds, deeper immersion, and smoother gameplay for a fresh experience.
body:
Philosophy of modding?
The vilmiComfort build is designed for those who want to transform Minecraft — make it bigger, more beautiful, and deeper. Here the world becomes alive and boundless, and the gameplay becomes an immersion in art. While I originally created this build for myself, I’d be happy to hear your constructive feedback and suggestions for improvement!

What’s New in Recent Updates?
In the latest versions, I’ve started shifting the approach toward "**non-vanilla**" modifications. Now, vilmiComfort includes mods like Refined Storage, Artifacts, and Traveler’s Backpack and more. I try to keep it compatible with vanilla servers, and I plan to release a separate "vanilla-friendly" version later.

Who is this build for?
For builders and creatives who want large-scale projects without restrictions on visibility.
For lovers of beautiful graphics who are willing to sacrifice some of their productivity for visual immersion.
For experimenters who are ready to test beta versions.

Note
The build is still a work in progress. I personally **recommend using BSL Shaders** for the best visual experience.

⚠️ Note on Translation & Community:
I’m not a native English speaker, so some phrasing might sound awkward or unclear.
